summary: The Sell section covers how partners and organizations take Business Central to customers: reselling online, onboarding customers, preparing company configuration packages, customizing the application, and selling apps through Marketplace. It answers questions about partner setup, licensing, onboarding tools, and app commercialization.
overview:
Sell is aimed mainly at partners who resell Business Central Online or distribute apps. It has five pages and no subtopics. Each page covers one step of the sales and delivery path.

Start with "Get started as a reseller of Business Central Online". It covers partner enrollment, go-to-market, customer onboarding and how licensing differs from on-premises. From there, "Set Up Company Configuration Packages" explains reusable templates that speed up standard company setups. "Onboarding experiences" and "Customize Business Central" describe how to help customers learn the product and tailor it to their roles. "Selling Business Central apps through Marketplace" covers commercial app distribution.
key_points: Reseller guide covers Microsoft Partner Network, Cloud Solution Provider, the indirect reseller model, delegated administrator access and Partner Center.
Licensing for the online reseller model differs from on-premises, and the guide explains the differences.

Company configuration packages are reusable deployment templates that use configuration templates, a configuration worksheet, master data import, a configuration questionnaire and RapidStart file export.
Onboarding tools for partners include a welcome banner, onboarding checklist, teaching tips, in-app tours and signup context.
Customization options include Role Center customization, the Experience setting, colored cues, page personalization and app installation.
Marketplace app selling involves enabling transactability, defining plans, creating entitlements and managing per-user licensing.
Marketplace topics also include side-by-side support, free trials and pricing models; the page references 2023 release wave 2.
